title: Favor market: spend Favor with a faction
summary: Each faction can now offer favors, items, secrets and services for Favor. The DM writes what is on offer, players ask, and the DM decides.
items: The DM fills each faction's favor market, from scratch or from optional templates such as a safe house for a night or forged papers, and can change it at any time.

Players ask for something with their own Favor and can add a note. Favor is spent only when the DM approves, never twice and never below zero; the DM can also decline with a reply or record a purchase made at the table.
A secret bought from a faction is shown only to the player who bought it. Nobody sees another player's requests or purchases.
